# `inverse`

the free-orientation minimum-norm kernel of a head model and a noise covariance.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run inverse --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run inverse --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run inverse --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --noise-cov emptyroom_noise_cov [--forward NAME] [--conventions mne] [--snr 3]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `forward` | operator forward, where {"name": "$forward"} | yes |
| `covariance` | statistic any, where {"measure": "covariance", "name": "$noise_cov"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `forward` | `--forward` | `none` | - |  | the head model's name, or none: the subject's one head model |
| `noise_cov` | `--noise-cov` | none | - |  | the noise covariance's name (a statistic: `nxr-neuro run noisecov` makes one) |
| `name` | `--name` | `{forward}_minnorm` | - |  | the kernel's name; beside it <name>_channels, <name>_noise_cov and <name>_whitener |
| `conventions` | `--conventions` | `brainstorm` | - | brainstorm, mne | the defaults every option starts from: brainstorm \| mne |
| `average_reference` | `--average-reference` | true | - |  | apply the average reference of EEG, sEEG and ECoG to the gain and the covariance, per family |
| `depth_weighting` | `--depth-weighting` | none | - |  | depth weighting on or off; null: the conventions' |
| `depth_exponent` | `--depth-exponent` | none | - |  | the depth weighting's exponent; null: the conventions' |
| `depth_limit` | `--depth-limit` | none | - |  | the largest ratio of the depth weights; null: the conventions' |
| `depth_norm` | `--depth-norm` | none | - |  | frobenius \| spectral; null: the conventions' |
| `depth_limit_on` | `--depth-limit-on` | none | - |  | weight \| norm; null: the conventions' |
| `depth_channels` | `--depth-channels` | none | - |  | all \| one_type; null: the conventions' |
| `snr` | `--snr` | none | - |  | the amplitude signal-to-noise ratio (lambda^2 = 1/snr^2); null: the conventions' |
| `snr_normalisation` | `--snr-normalisation` | none | - |  | all_channels \| whitener_rank; null: the conventions' |
| `regularisation` | `--regularisation` | none | - |  | the noise covariance's regularisation: ridge \| diagonal \| none; null: the conventions' |
| `ridge_fraction` | `--ridge-fraction` | none | fraction |  | the ridge's fraction of the mean eigenvalue; null: the conventions' |
| `whitener_form` | `--whitener-form` | none | - |  | symmetric \| pca; null: the conventions' |
| `rank_tolerance` | `--rank-tolerance` | none | - |  | single \| double; null: the conventions' |
| `joint_types` | `--joint-types` | none | - |  | whiten the types of a modality jointly (MEG MAG with MEG GRAD); null: the conventions' |
| `ridge_over_rank` | `--ridge-over-rank` | none | - |  | the ridge's mean eigenvalue over the rank, not the channel count; null: the conventions' |
| `detect_diagonal` | `--detect-diagonal` | none | - |  | whiten a diagonal covariance by its diagonal; null: the conventions' |

## Presets

`--set <preset>` sets the parameters below at once; a parameter given by name wins over the preset.

| preset | sets |
|---|---|
| `brainstorm` | conventions=brainstorm |
| `mne` | conventions=mne |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE MINIMUM-NORM KERNEL (free orientation) of a subject: from a head model (an operator of kind forward, gain channels x 3 sources) and a noise covariance (a statistic over
a pick of the head model's channels: `nxr-neuro run noisecov` first). The gain is restricted to the pick; the average reference of EEG, sEEG and ECoG is applied to the gain
and the covariance per family (average_reference false: not); every option starts from the conventions (brainstorm or mne) and may be set on its own.
Stored: the inverse kernel `<name>` (an operator from the channels to the head model's sources, vector3, the inverse of the head model), its channels `<name>_channels`,
the covariance it was computed with `<name>_noise_cov` (a statistic of the covariance given) and its symmetric whitener `<name>_whitener` (an operator of that statistic).

  nxr-neuro run inverse --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --noise-cov emptyroom_noise_cov [--forward NAME] [--conventions mne] [--snr 3]
```
